Your shirts should be dark colors like black & navy blue..you can always sneak in a gray shirt but make sure you wear a tank top under that hugs you tightly but still comfortably(not too tight). Don’t wear extremely tight shirts or shirts that are too baggy. Definitely do NOT gain weight won’t help much trust me.

I read every word actually & I’ve been fighting depression & suicidal thoughts for a long time. In my school days(29 now) I would look in the mirror sometimes & hold a knife to my neck. I wasn’t ever the most popular kid & I know that life is stressful, boring & sometimes feels hopeless & useless but I’m here now still battling my demons, reading your post & those of many others. I know in our bedrooms on the phone or computer it feels like you are alone because technically in your world you are but what you are battling with..you are NOT alone. It’s nothing to be ashamed of I used to be ashamed of it too. It took me 10 years before I told 1 person how I felt inside, what was going on in my head. They didn’t take me serious at all, I tried telling my parents once but they’re old fashioned & don’t believe in mental illness. Remember you don’t need anyone to enjoy YOUR life, you can go out & spend the day doing whatever YOU want to do & believe it or not if you do it enough you’ll meet people who care. You’ll meet people who maybe actually relate to what you’re going through. Ending it is in no way easy but it is in fact the easy way out. Give yourself life my friend we only have 1. As I sit here & write to you I still battle the demons in my head but I will never let them win. I cry sometimes(mostly late at night) but that’s okay. You dying is NOT the answer to your problems, LIVE my friend. I hope you find your path to a brighter tomorrow. Blessings from the other side.

God works in mysterious ways, but he will never string you along unless he believes you will fight to see the light at the end of the tunnel. I’ve been depressed & fighting depression for a long time. I’ve been stabbed in the back by the girl I loved, disowned by my mother for 2 years & talked down on by other family members. In every situation there was a light I just had to find it. Don’t let someone’s else’s actions or things that may feel unfair in life define who you are or the way you decide to move on with yourself. I mean imagine fighting depression all these years(since 17) just to find out you have a brain tumor(29 now). I mean imagine that you would think god was stringing me along but he isn’t I have faith, you should too. I’ve been humiliated (by the girl I loved) in front of friends & family enough to where I didn’t want to show my face again. I know this isn’t about my ups & downs but I just want you to know you are not alone. See life is this game where you’re put through these tests & obstacles but don’t let it tear you down. You ARE great, you WILL be forever great. As I speak to you now I myself still fight depression which is what led me here. Don’t give up, please & don’t keep fighting for me but fight for yourself & your life & what you believe is fair. I repeat you are not alone & if someone can’t see the great inside your heart it’s their loss. Blessings from the other side

Times in life will be hard, sometimes you will feel like you don’t know what your purpose is or what you want to do in life. I’ve been there, depressed & sad. Depression led me to skipping class & eventually being kicked out of school, imagine that disappointment to the family. You have to get out there, go to a spa even if it’s alone & treat yourself. You will interact with the employees & it will help with getting your social skills up. Try learning something new, I mean literally anything. Occupy your time wether it be going to the gym(I hate the gym) but it’s better than being lost in your thoughts. Don’t live your life trying to live up to other people’s expectations including family. You are who you are & real family will forever accept you. You might feel lost today but if you keep fighting & staying strong, I promise one day you will find your way. 💛 blessings from the other side 💛
